description: Added `smithy_aws_core.endpoints.AWS_RULES_EXTENSION`, which adds AWS support to endpoint rules resolution. It provides the `aws.partition`, `aws.parseArn` and `aws.isVirtualHostableS3Bucket` functions, binds the AWS built-ins to client config, and maps the `sigv4`, `sigv4a` and `sigv4-s3express` auth schemes to their scheme IDs.
